description: Vishal Misra returns to explain his latest research on how LLMs actually work under the hood. He walks through experiments showing that transformers update their predictions in a precise, mathematically predictable way as they process new information, explains why this still doesn't mean they're conscious, and describes what's actually required for AGI: the ability to keep learning after training and the move from pattern matching to understanding cause and effect. Resources: Follow Vishal Misra…
classificationReason: Deep technical discussion of transformer behavior, continual learning, causal understanding, and requirements for AGI; relevant to embodied-AI foundations but not directly about robots.
qualityReason: Likely substantive original research interview with named researchers and a clear technical focus.
